about: The days a month's page shows (spec/calendar.md, The month). weeks: whole weeks covering `month` ("YYYY-MM"), each starting on `weekStart` (0 for Sunday through 6 for Saturday), the days of the months around it filling the first and last; `expected` gives the first day shown, the last, and how many weeks, four to six. The page keeps room for six whatever the count.

weeks.name: a month from a Thursday, weeks from Sunday
the same month, weeks from Monday, runs into the next
the same month, weeks from Saturday, takes six
a February from the week's first day fills four weeks exactly
a long month from a Saturday spans six weeks
the first weeks of a year start in the year before
a leap February ends on its 29th
